describes: `409` · `RECEIPT_NOT_READY`. The order was rejected or cancelled before the restaurant accepted: the authorisation was voided, nothing was charged, and no receipt will ever exist. The app says "You were not charged" instead of offering a receipt. Same body as `error_receipt_not_ready`; the app tells the cases apart by the order's state.

error.message: This order does not have a receipt yet.
